subject: Re: Status: archive live internally, eval numbers, one serving risk
body:
Team,

Go/no-go outcome from yesterday:

1. GO on the reforecast archive as a platform dataset. The calibration story at 1h and 6h horizons carried the room; we will document the 12-hour sharpness degradation in the dataset card rather than pretend it is not there.
2. CONDITIONAL on the real-time feed. Zeke agreed the geo-feature caching fix is plausible, but we are not announcing a 30-minute-fresh product while preprocessing eats 11 minutes. Milan owns getting preprocessing under 5 minutes; we re-review in Q2 with actual latency numbers, not projections.
3. Scope cut: per-customer regional fine-tunes are out of this window entirely.

Wei, Vera - nice eval work, the thresholds table is exactly what the review needed. Archive announcement drafts to me by 4/17.

Dmitri
